name: Kimi no Nagori wa Shizuka ni Yurete
original_name: 君の名残は静かに揺れて
source:
This is an ‘if’ story from UnisonShift’s popular 2009 title Flyable Heart, focusing on Mayuri. 

One day, Shou received a student pass from the famous private school Hootori Ryouran Gakuen and decides to head there, tempted by free food. There, he meets a girl who is looking far into the distance. Her feelings could not be expressed as simply as lonely or sad.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/05/15/may-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这是UnisonShift于2009年推出的人气作品《Flyable Heart》的一段“如果”故事，焦点落在茉百合身上。

一天，翔收到名门私立学校凤繚兰学园的学生证。受到免费食物的诱惑，他决定前往那里。在学园中，他遇见了一名眺望远方的少女。她的心情无法简单地用寂寞或悲伤来形容。

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/05/15/may-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
